dict.string: Juno needs permission to control other applications and automate tasks on your behalf.
Juno needs permission to access system administration features for automation.
Juno needs accessibility permissions to interact with other applications and perform automation tasks.
Juno needs microphone access for voice transcription and dictation features.
Juno needs camera access for screen recording and visual analysis features.
Juno needs input monitoring permissions to register global keyboard shortcuts for voice control and automation features.
Juno needs screen capture permissions to take screenshots and analyze the desktop for automation tasks.
Juno needs access to your Desktop folder to help with file operations and automation tasks.
Juno needs access to your Documents folder to help with file operations and automation tasks.
Juno needs access to your Downloads folder to help with file operations and automation tasks.
